Subject: Commit path & capacity timeline — proposed QBR dates and next steps

Hi Sofia / Tom,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great conversation and clear signal that PayFlow will need +30% steady-state capacity for peak payroll cycles starting Sep. To keep your latency targets and get ahead of the seasonality, we recommend converting the current monthly plan into a 12‑month committed contract with a stepped capacity uplift.

Proposed high-level commit path (attached term sheet):
- Jun 1: sign amendment (12-month term, 30% committed uplift)
- Jun 15–30: canary increase (20% traffic routed to dedicated pool)
- Jul 1: full capacity shift for non-peak; Sep 1: full peak coverage

We can offer a 10% blended discount on committed units if PayFlow signs the amendment by Jun 8. Procurement will need the term sheet and an updated invoice; I attached a draft and some QBR date options.

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick internal review on pricing and SLO exceptions (Ben / Dylan) — can you confirm feasibility by Tue 5/23?
2) Sofia / Tom — pick a QBR slot from the attached .ics so we can lock the calendar; recommended slots are Jun 12 or Jun 20.
3) Marissa, can CS own onboarding workstream and confirm resource plan for the canary?

Open items: a) any regulatory review required for expanded data retention for payroll logs, b) PO timeline if procurement needs extra approvals.

Attachments: RDW-2376_proposed_term_sheet_v1.pdf (term sheet, redlines allowed), QBR_date_options.ics (calendar invites)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
